item: Use of NBA statistics for betting models and lines
why: NBA Terms §9 says NBA Statistics may not be used in connection with any gambling activity, including legal gambling, and may not feed a comprehensive regularly updated statistics database without express prior consent.
action: Obtain written permission from NBA, or source statistics from a provider whose terms allow this use. Get legal review before any model that uses NBA.com statistics.

item: Offering online sports betting or betting lines to Dutch customers
why: Ksa says only holders of a Koa licence under art. 31a of the Betting and Gaming Act may offer online gambling, including bets on sports matches. The owner is located in Naaldwijk, NL.
action: Get Dutch legal counsel on (a) private analysis versus offering picks or lines to others and (b) licensing. Do not offer betting products to NL residents without a licence.

why: The repository has no licensed odds feed, no historical dataset, and no validated model. Without these, no line can be originated or validated, and no pick can be responsibly generated.
action: Decide on a licensed odds and statistics source (SG-02). No picks are published.

item: Historical box scores, minutes, play-by-play, and prop outcomes
why: No authorized dataset is in the repository. The NBA terms restrict statistics use (7C-F-01).
action: Inventory authorized data with provenance and licence terms.

item: Injury effect on rotation minutes and production
why: The official report gives status and reason only; it has no minutes or production fields (S04 header). No minutes projection source is verified.
action: Build from authorized minutes data after 7C-F-01 and 7C-F-02 are resolved. Nothing is estimated here.

item: All correlation values and parlay joint probabilities
why: No outcomes, prices, or samples are available. Blank by policy.
action: Measure out-of-sample with uncertainty once data passes G0–G2 (validation page).
